# one email per row: links, "!" marks
X = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 1],
              [4, 3], [3, 4], [5, 4], [4, 5]])

w = d / 3                     # same direction, tidier numbers
mid = (mu_normal + mu_spam) / 2
b = w @ mid

import numpy as np

# one email per row: links, "!" marks
X = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 1],
              [4, 3], [3, 4], [5, 4], [4, 5]])
y = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1])  # 0 = normal, 1 = spam

mu_normal = X[y == 0].mean(axis=0)
mu_spam = X[y == 1].mean(axis=0)
dev_n = X[y == 0] - mu_normal   # each email minus its own centre
dev_s = X[y == 1] - mu_spam
S_w = dev_n.T @ dev_n + dev_s.T @ dev_s
print(S_w)
print(np.linalg.solve(S_w, mu_spam - mu_normal))

import numpy as np

# columns: sqft, bedrooms, distance_km (one house per row)
X = np.array([[1100, 2, 8],
              [1500, 3, 5],
              [900, 1, 2],
              [2000, 4, 12],
              [1300, 2, 3],
              [1800, 3, 9],
              [2400, 4, 6],
              [1000, 2, 15]])
y = np.array([265, 370, 248, 440, 335, 418, 560, 205])  # price in $k

F = X[:, [0, 2]] / [1000, 1]   # size in 1000 sqft, distance in km
pricey = y >= 400
mu_cheap = F[~pricey].mean(axis=0)
mu_pricey = F[pricey].mean(axis=0)
w = mu_pricey - mu_cheap
b = w @ (mu_cheap + mu_pricey) / 2
print(np.round(w, 2), np.round(b, 2))
print(F @ w > b)
print(((F @ w > b) == pricey).sum(), "of 8 right")

import numpy as np

# columns: sqft, bedrooms, distance_km (one house per row)
X = np.array([[1100, 2, 8],
              [1500, 3, 5],
              [900, 1, 2],
              [2000, 4, 12],
              [1300, 2, 3],
              [1800, 3, 9],
              [2400, 4, 6],
              [1000, 2, 15]])
y = np.array([265, 370, 248, 440, 335, 418, 560, 205])  # price in $k

F = X[:, [0, 2]] / [1000, 1]   # size in 1000 sqft, distance in km
pricey = y >= 400
mu_cheap = F[~pricey].mean(axis=0)
mu_pricey = F[pricey].mean(axis=0)
w = mu_pricey - mu_cheap
dev_c = F[~pricey] - mu_cheap
dev_p = F[pricey] - mu_pricey
S_w = dev_c.T @ dev_c + dev_p.T @ dev_p
w = np.linalg.solve(S_w, w)   # the scatter correction
b = w @ (mu_cheap + mu_pricey) / 2
print(np.round(w, 2), np.round(b, 2))
print(F @ w > b)
print(((F @ w > b) == pricey).sum(), "of 8 right")
